trend_pullback.name: Trend pullback
trend_pullback.about: Buy dips in an up-trend, sell rallies in a down-trend. Trend: EMA 20 above EMA 50 and price above VWAP (or both below). Entry: RSI(14) pulls back under the dip line within the last few candles, then crosses back above 50 (mirror for shorts). Target and stop are set in ATRs, the market's typical bar size.

orb_trend.name: Opening-range breakout
orb_trend.about: The first 15 minutes set a range. Buy the first candle that closes above its high when EMA 9 is above EMA 21 and ADX(14) shows a trend (or sell the first close below its low, mirror). Stop at the middle of the range, target a multiple of the range.

vwap_snapback.name: VWAP snap-back
vwap_snapback.about: On a quiet, range-bound day (ADX low), a stretch outside the Bollinger band with RSI at an extreme tends to snap back towards VWAP. Buy below the lower band with RSI under the low line (sell above the upper band, mirror); target VWAP, stop in ATRs.

gap_fill.name: Gap fill
gap_fill.about: When NIFTY opens with a gap and the first 15 minutes move against the gap, trade back towards yesterday's close. Gap up + red first 15 minutes + price below VWAP: sell (gap down: mirror). Target: part of the gap, stop above the day's high (below the low) plus a buffer.

ema_st_adx.name: EMA crossover + Supertrend
ema_st_adx.about: Trend following with three checks: EMA fast crosses EMA slow, Supertrend(10, 3) points the same way, ADX(14) confirms a trend, and price is on the right side of VWAP. Target and stop in ATRs; also out when price closes back across the slow EMA.
